text: {"lessons":["Several months of gains came while I made no trades, so checking prices often does not mean I need to act; I should trade only when my plan gives a clear reason.","Selling parts of Stocks E and A locked in gains, but a profitable sale alone does not prove I timed it well; I should judge decisions against my goals and the portfolio as a whole.","My account value moved through both declines and recoveries, so I should stay focused on the ten-year apartment goal, keep a sensible cash reserve, and avoid reacting to short-term changes."]}
